item.title: From Cricket to the Catwalk: Australian Pop Newcomer Oliver Cronin Has Created His Own Piece of ‘Paradise’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show, where we dive into the world of music and meet the talents that are making waves. Today, we're shining the spotlight on Oliver Cronin, a rising star from Australia.
[Soft background music starts]
Host: You might be surprised to learn that Oliver's journey to music stardom could have taken a very different turn. As a teenager, he was a talented cricketer, selected for state teams and on track to join the national team. But music stole his heart, and he had to make a choice.
[Clip of Oliver Cronin speaking]
Oliver Cronin: "I had to choose between music and cricket because I understood what it took to be elite at something. And it takes a lot."
Host: Oliver chose music, and with the support of his family, he dedicated himself to studying the music business, writing songs, and learning the art of music production. His hard work paid off, and at just 24 years old, he's signed with Warner Music Australia and releasing his new EP, Lost On The Way To Paradise.
[Clip of music plays]
Host: This EP is the follow-up to his successful 2024 release, Halfway To Paradise, which took him on a global tour, performing in North America, Canada, Germany, and more. Oliver's music has caught fire on TikTok, where he has 1.1 million followers, and his releases have gone viral in countries like India, the Philippines, and Germany.
[Clip of music continues]
Host: Oliver's not just a musician, though. He's also a fashion enthusiast, and earlier this year, he debuted on the catwalk at Australian Fashion Week 2026.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's show. Oliver Cronin is an exciting talent to watch, and we can't wait to see what he does next. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!
